background: Nicole A. Wagon is the Fremont County commissioner-elect for District 1 and takes office in January 2027, succeeding Clarence V. Thomas, who is serving through the current term. County 10 reported after the August 18, 2026, Republican primary that she filed to run as an Independent in the November general election, and that County Clerk Julie Freese confirmed she had met the filing requirements. She defeated Republican David Mossburg in the November 3, 2026, general election. No separate public-record account of her private occupation or education was found in the official pages and other public records reviewed for this Profile.
